{{Quote|The Lurid Aurora is a shroud of uncertainty. Is she a foe... or an ally? Our enemies hide within her embrace, waiting for us. Yet, when Lady Luck turns her head away from us, the Lurid Aurora sighs and her ethereal breath clouds the vision of our enemies. To me, she is a friend. And to her, we're all the same.|A [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] poet|<ref name="SWG:TCTL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Journal Entry: "Talonbane Cobra: The Lure"}}</ref>}}
The '''Lurid Aurora Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Lucent Ivaya]] quadrant of the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], [[Laetin A'shera]]'s [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots killed the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Talonbane Cobra/Legends|Talonbane Cobra]] in the nebula.<ref name="SWG:AtA" />
